directions: From Longford test centre on Ardnacassa Avenue, move off when safe and take the 1st left to stay on Ardnacassa Avenue
Continue for a short distance turn right onto Major's Well Road and follow it out for just over a kilometre, keeping an eye on your speed and position as the road opens up
At the roundabout ahead take the slight left exit onto the Longford Bypass
Stay on the bypass, watching for lane discipline and traffic joining from slip roads
